whatItDoes: Group plans die in the group chat. OurSpaces gives a friend group a persistent shared canvas — countdowns, polls, potluck sheets, photo piles — that every member sees update live, cursor to cursor. 32 widget types, one board per space.

demoPath.entry: This URL opens the complete live production application—not a landing page, mockup, demo shell, or placeholder. It is reachable, fully functional, loaded with real shared data, and demonstrates the shipped collaborative product directly.
tryTogether: Open the crew board in two tabs, then cast the cake poll: a Convex mutation writes the vote and the reactive query updates both tabs.
Claim the open party item, post a birthday message, change availability, or upload a photo; each action appears for every viewer.
Drag any card to see the other tab's live cursor and moving card. The black live-sync pill reads the Convex client's WebSocket state directly.

implementationVerification.schema: Exceptional, deep and idiomatic rather than broad for its own sake: 12 domain tables use 29 access-pattern indexes, typed document relationships, deliberate hot-path denormalization, a space-filtered full-text index, a 1536-dimensional vector index, and a 33-arm widget-data union with 32 specific validators.
implementationVerification.functions: Exemplary at scale: all 145 queries, mutations and actions have return validators; reads use targeted indexes and cursor pagination; writes enforce space scope; external I/O stays in actions; and internal functions, aggregates, scheduling, work pools, workflows, retries, caching and rate limits do their intended operational jobs.
implementationVerification.realtime: Foundational and production-proven across the product, not an isolated demo: subscriptions drive the canvas, cursors, gestures, votes, messages, availability, paint, crawl progress, AI streams, occupancy and deploy refreshes.
implementationVerification.depth: Convex owns the database, backend functions, realtime sync, auth, files, AI gateway, scheduled work, components, HTTP routes and frontend hosting. The repository and live application directly substantiate this complete, correct integration.

frontend: React 19 + Vite + Tailwind v4 on @convex-dev/static-hosting; HTTP routes under /api.

schema.tablesNote: 12 of our own; @convex-dev/auth's ...authTables are spread in on top, uncounted.
schema.typedWidgetData: widgets.data is a 33-arm union (convex/widgetData.ts): 32 typed per-widget validators plus one open fallback arm.

functions.note: 145 = 43 queries + 69 mutations + 33 actions; every one has a returns: validator. httpAction handlers return a Response instead.

features: Realtime reactive queries drive every board and thread.
Cursor pagination (.paginate) on message threads; full-text search index on messages, filtered by spaceId.
Vector index widgets.by_embedding + ctx.vectorSearch (convex/similar.ts): an arriving link asks whether the board already holds it.
Scheduler, internal mutations, 4 crons (convex/crons.ts), file storage behind the photo walls.

HTTP router (convex/http.ts): /api/ask-stream is the live ask path — persistent-text-streaming streams the answer to the asking tab and persists it for everyone else; svix-HMAC-verified inbound AgentMail webhook.

auth.modes: Anonymous guest sessions, plus join with a six-digit code emailed from the space's AgentMail inbox (convex/otp.ts).
auth.note: Identity comes from getAuthUserId() (@convex-dev/auth), which wraps ctx.auth — nothing of ours calls ctx.auth directly.

ai.provider: Convex AI Gateway (https://ai-gateway.convex.dev/v1) via @convex-dev/ai-sdk-provider + getServiceToken("ai-gateway"): every call authenticates as the deployment on a per-call credential, no API key of ours in the path.
chatModels: openai/gpt-4o-mini — structured JSON decisions (completeJson → the gateway's /v1/chat/completions) and the agent component's model (convexGateway(), convex/agent.ts)
ai.embeddingModel: openai/text-embedding-3-small, 1536 dimensions — rag retrieval and the widgets.by_embedding echo index, on the same gateway through an OpenAI-compatible client.
